comparison.objective: Thread and tighten a spin-on oil filter to a controlled post-gasket-contact angle or, in intermediate versions, a specified wrench torque; candidate selectively rejects open cartons on a conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous axial-threaded rotation, wrist-roll attribution, regrasping and optional cap-wrench/ratchet use versus translational tracking, flap-safe opposed grasp and spill-free transport.
comparison.success_condition: Hand-tight versions require 240–360° past contact without over-tightening or unthreading and released hold; wrench variants additionally require tool-mediated torque. Candidate uses carton retention, tray release/dwell and untouched downstream passage.
comparison.reason: Thread engagement and bounded tightening test a different ability from conveyor interception and loaded-carton handling. All 16 supplied spec versions were represented; their hand-versus-wrench rubric changes do not create plausible overlap with the candidate.
